claim: A critic agent that poses probing scientific questions challenging assumptions and focus guides simulations and experiments to target key mechanisms and outcomes.
falsifier: In a multi-agent scientific discovery system, introduce a critic agent that generates probing questions challenging assumptions and measure whether the resulting simulations and experiments more frequently target key mechanisms and outcomes compared to a system without such a critic.

conditions: the critic agent is integrated into a multi-agent system
the critic agent poses probing questions that challenge assumptions and focus
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported system, tasks, and experimental conditions; transfer beyond them is unestablished.

title: Critic agent posing probing for simulations and experiments target
